test_title: PYST 02: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 05 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which schedule allows for the creation of village councils or courts for tribal cases?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sixth Schedule**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Sixth Schedule** of the Indian Constitution provides for the **administration of tribal areas in the states of Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram**.
 
• It allows for the establishment of **Autonomous District Councils (ADCs)**, which are empowered to make laws and govern certain aspects of administration in tribal areas.
 
• The ADCs are authorized to create **village councils or courts** for handling disputes and cases involving tribal individuals, ensuring their customary laws and practices are preserved.
 
• This schedule provides a legal framework to protect the rights and culture of tribal communities while granting them **self-governance**.
 
• The Sixth Schedule seeks to empower tribal regions by granting them autonomy in areas such as land use, resource management, and administration of justice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Autonomous District Councils (ADCs):**

 
 
• ADCs are created under the Sixth Schedule to administer tribal areas and protect tribal rights.
 
• They have the authority to legislate on matters such as land, forests, water, customs, and inheritance.
 
• ADCs are composed of members both elected and nominated by the Governor of the respective state.
 
 
 
• **Tribal Courts:**
 
 
• Village councils or courts established under ADCs are empowered to handle cases involving tribal individuals in accordance with customary laws.
 
• These courts aim to ensure quick and culturally sensitive resolution of disputes within tribal communities.
 
 
 
• **Other Schedules Related to Tribals:**
 
 
• The Fifth Schedule of the Indian Constitution deals with the administration and control of Scheduled Areas and Scheduled Tribes in other states (excluding the Sixth Schedule states).
 
• The Sixth Schedule, however, provides a more autonomous framework for certain northeastern states.
 
 
 
• **Importance of the Sixth Schedule:**
 
 
• It preserves the unique cultural identity and traditions of tribal communities.
 
• It ensures self-governance and participatory democracy within tribal areas.
